steps.content: As the first grey light of dawn filters into the room, the last calibration is complete.
With a steady hand, Hilda takes the final, crucial gear and slots it into place. A soft, yet definitive click echoes in the quiet room, and a green indicator light glows to life.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: There. It is complete now.
A heavy silence descends. For a moment, everyone is frozen, suspended between exhaustion and the uncertainty of what comes next.
Hilda lets out a cold laugh.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...What's the matter? I expected our "mole" would have made a move by now.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Hmm... This presents two possibilities. First, is the mole even still among the living? Perhaps Huck, who fell in the chaos, was the culprit after all?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even if the Monolith is the target, confronting four people to steal a machine of this size would be a suicidal move.
And that's precisely why you haven't made your move yet. This prototype is simply too large to steal right in front of these people. What you really need is more detailed intelligence.
The blueprints, or perhaps the core component.

steps.speaker: Helene
steps.content: Oh, for heaven's sake... What "move" are you all waiting for? Just crate this thing up and ship it out! I'm so sick of this place. I want to go home!

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: Wait. What does this indicator mean?
A low, ominous hum fills the air as the indicator light snaps from green to a glaring red.
That familiar, chilling presence—Mania—washes over you again.
At the same moment, a piercing alarm shrieks from the Monolith. Panels on all four sides erupt in a frantic, synchronized strobe of light.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: What on earth...
The machine is going haywire.
The terrifying conclusion is inescapable. The crowd can only stare, speechless, as the screens dissolve into a torrent of data.
"Gexyl wz vcoebmn."
"G93ZXIgaXMgZ3VpbHQu"
"YzJCZmN1bVpQdVYrMXBveHFKaXhBdz09"
Numbers and letters skitter and swarm across the screen in a taunting dance, finally collapsing into a single, glaring string of deep red.

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: This... this code is...!
<color=#dg1f1f>Wklv lv qrw d jliw. Lw lv brxu judyh.</color>

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: A Caesar cipher. Offset by three. The first lesson for every cryptographer...
<color=#dg1f1f>This is not a gift. It is your grave.</color>
<color=#dg1f1f>2:00:00</color>
Beep, beep, beep...
Two hours until the Monolith explodes...

■ Eliminated Outlands spies: Huck Burrows, Casey Abel, Marlo Bannings

■ All 30 estate guards confirmed dead. Investigation confirms they were secretly recruited by a farland resistance group, which operated under DisCity's name to conduct separatist activities and retaliate against the metropoles.

■ The estate has sustained severe structural damage. All previous entry and exit restrictions have been lifted.
■ The Monolith prototype has been compromised by the mole, currently awaiting decontamination and restoration.

Keys Obtained: <color=#fb9259><size=52><u>3</color></size></u>


Consciousness Restoration: <color=#fb9259><size=52><u>60%</color></size></u>

□ Among the three remaining people, who is the mole?
